messages.subject: Activity Overlap title error
parts:
Hello!

For some reason, the plot of an activity overlap I have entered continues to have errors in the title. Currently, the title says "subset_speciesA$Time.rad and subsetspeciesB$Time.rad." I have tried with several species and all titles end up looking like this. Any idea of what's causing this?
Thanks for your help!

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Activity Overlap title error
parts:
This is a change in the new version 1.0 of the package. In previous versions, the main title was fixed and could not be removed.
Now you can change or remove it by setting argument main. See the vignette for an example. Set main = "" to remove the title.

The issue is that main is passed to overlapPlot, which uses a different input (2 vectors of times instead of a data frame). So what shows up in the title is the names of those 2 time vectors, which are columns of your record table (hence "subset_speciesA$Time.rad and subsetspeciesB$Time.rad.")

I agree the implementation is not ideal. It might be better to create the old title by default if argument main is not set, and only change the title when main is specified. What do you think?
